description: GitLab CI/CD pipeline automation: .gitlab-ci.yml DAG stages, Docker-in-Docker runners, multi-project pipeline triggers, caching strategies, and protected environments with approval gates.
instructionsMarkdown:
# GitLab CI/CD Pipeline Architecture & Governance

Design enterprise-grade, deterministic continuous integration and delivery pipelines in GitLab.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Define pipeline stages as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) using `needs:` for parallel execution.
- Cache dependencies keyed by the hash of lockfiles (`key: files: [package-lock.json]`).
- Restrict sensitive CI/CD variables strictly to `protected` and `masked` configurations.
- Require manual human approval gates on deployments targeting production environments.
